# raw-hosted (raw hosted) at http://gateway.test/gw
# set ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN to a credential with access to this repository

## download
curl --fail --location -H "Authorization: Bearer $ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN" --output <file> http://gateway.test/gw/raw/raw-hosted/<path>

## upload
curl --fail -H "Authorization: Bearer $ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN" --upload-file <file> http://gateway.test/gw/raw/raw-hosted/<path>
